attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: full_article_publishing_pipeline
steps:
  - id: search_google_drive
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "/api/google-drive/search"
      query:
        folder: "pending_articles"
        mime_type: "application/pdf"
    output: raw_drive_results

  - id: validate_drive_results
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_drive_results
      schema: drive_search_results_schema
    output: validated_drive_results

  - id: loop_pdf_files
    op: loop_records
    params:
      input: validated_drive_results
      step: download_pdf_binary

  - id: download_pdf_binary
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "/api/google-drive/download"
      file_id_from: validated_drive_results
    output: raw_pdf_binary

  - id: validate_pdf_binary
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_pdf_binary
      schema: pdf_binary_schema
    output: validated_pdf_binary

  - id: send_to_ai_vision
    op: call_webhook
    params:
      url: "/api/ai-vision/extract"
      method: "POST"
      input: validated_pdf_binary
      content_type: "application/pdf"
    output: raw_ai_response

  - id: authenticate_publisher
    op: authenticate_user
    params:
      role: "publisher"
    output: auth_result

  - id: validate_ai_response
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_ai_response
      schema: ai_extraction_response_schema
    output: validated_ai_response

  - id: check_multiple_articles
    op: apply_rule
    params:
      rule: "es_multiple_check"
      condition: "validated_ai_response.es_multiple == true"
      input: validated_ai_response
    output: multiple_check_result

  - id: route_multiple_or_single
    op: route_to_step
    params:
      condition: "multiple_check_result.is_multiple == true"
      true_step: loop_multiple_reviews
      false_step: normalise_title

  - id: loop_multiple_reviews
    op: loop_records
    params:
      input: validated_ai_response
      collection_field: "reviews"
      step: normalise_title

  - id: normalise_title
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: validated_ai_response
      mapping:
        title: "normalised_title"
        content: "raw_content"
        author: "author_name"
        metadata: "article_metadata"
    output: normalised_article

  - id: fetch_category_spreadsheet
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "/api/google-drive/spreadsheet"
      spreadsheet_id: "category_mapping_excel"
    output: raw_category_data

  - id: validate_category_data
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_category_data
      schema: category_spreadsheet_schema
    output: validated_category_data

  - id: match_category
    op: filter_records
    params:
      input: validated_category_data
      condition: "title matches normalised_article.normalised_title"
    output: matched_categories

  - id: apply_default_category_rule
    op: apply_rule
    params:
      rule: "default_category_fallback"
      condition: "matched_categories is empty"
      default_value:
        category: "general_economics"
        flagged_for_review: true
    output: category_assignment

  - id: flag_no_match_for_review
    op: route_to_step
    params:
      condition: "category_assignment.flagged_for_review == true"
      true_step: notify_review_needed
      false_step: convert_content_to_html

  - id: notify_review_needed
    op: notify_user
    params:
      input: normalised_article
      recipient: "editor@economics-magazine.com"
      template: "category_no_match_review"
      message: "Article has no Excel category match - published with default category"

  - id: convert_content_to_html
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: normalised_article
      mapping:
        raw_content: "html_content"
        format_type: "interview_or_standard"
        paragraphs: "html_paragraph_blocks"
    output: html_article

  - id: lookup_cms_metadata
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "/api/cms/lookup"
      query:
        author_name: "normalised_article.author_name"
        category: "category_assignment.category"
        magazine_issue: "normalised_article.article_metadata.issue"
    output: raw_cms_metadata

  - id: validate_cms_metadata
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_cms_metadata
      schema: cms_metadata_schema
    output: validated_cms_metadata

  - id: extract_author_id
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: validated_cms_metadata
      field: "author_id"
    output: author_id

  - id: extract_category_uuid
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: validated_cms_metadata
      field: "category_uuid"
    output: category_uuid

  - id: extract_magazine_uuid
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: validated_cms_metadata
      field: "magazine_uuid"
    output: magazine_uuid

  - id: retrieve_csrf_token
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "/api/cms/csrf-token"
    output: raw_csrf_token

  - id: validate_csrf_token
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_csrf_token
      schema: csrf_token_schema
    output: validated_csrf_token

  - id: extract_csrf_value
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: validated_csrf_token
      field: "token"
    output: csrf_token

  - id: prepare_paragraph_payload
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: html_article
      mapping:
        html_paragraph_blocks: "paragraph_entities"
        csrf_token: "csrf_token"
    output: paragraph_payload

  - id: create_paragraph_blocks
    op: call_webhook
    params:
      url: "/api/cms/entity/paragraph"
      method: "POST"
      input: paragraph_payload
      headers:
        X-CSRF-Token: "csrf_token"
    output: raw_paragraph_refs

  - id: validate_paragraph_refs
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_paragraph_refs
      schema: paragraph_references_schema
    output: validated_paragraph_refs

  - id: prepare_article_node_payload
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: validated_paragraph_refs
      mapping:
        title: "normalised_article.normalised_title"
        author_id: "author_id"
        category_uuid: "category_uuid"
        magazine_uuid: "magazine_uuid"
        paragraph_references: "validated_paragraph_refs"
        html_content: "html_article.html_content"
    output: article_node_payload

  - id: create_article_node
    op: call_webhook
    params:
      url: "/api/cms/node/article"
      method: "POST"
      input: article_node_payload
      headers:
        X-CSRF-Token: "csrf_token"
    output: raw_article_node_result

  - id: validate_article_node_result
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_article_node_result
      schema: article_node_result_schema
    output: validated_article_result

  - id: log_article_published
    op: log_audit
    params:
      input: validated_article_result
      event: "article_published"
      details:
        title: "normalised_article.normalised
